def.personaje: {sujeto} is the character in {tags}[[: {ficha}]].[[ {Posesivo} name is {nombre}.]]
def.atuendos: In each shot {pronombre} {lleva} the outfit of the reference cited for that shot.
def.objeto: {sujeto} is the [[{nombre} ]]object shown in {tag}[[: {ficha}]]; it is the same object in every shot where it appears.
resumen: A music edit of {protagonista}[[ ({estilo})]], cut on the beat of <Audio 1>[[: {arco}]].
ret.personaje: {sujeto}: fully_preserved - [[{nombre}'s ]]face, hair and features from {tags} stay the same in every shot.
ret.objeto: {sujeto}: fully_preserved - the shape, colors, materials and markings of the {nombre|object} from {tag} wherever it appears.
ret.lugar: {tag}: fully_preserved - the {nombre|place}: its layout, architecture, colors and light fixtures stay the same in every shot set there; any person in it is not transferred.
ret.ropa: {tag}: attribute_transfer - only the clothes are transferred[[ ({nombre})]]; that person's face, hair and body are not transferred.
ret.pose: {tag}: attribute_transfer - only the body pose; that person's face, hair and clothes are not transferred.
ret.fondo: {tag}: attribute_transfer - only the place and its background are transferred; any person in it is not transferred.
ret.estilo: {tag}: attribute_transfer - only the visual style is transferred.
ret.efecto: {tag}: attribute_transfer - only its look is transferred.
ret.letra: {tag}: attribute_transfer - only its lettering style is transferred; the words written in it are not reproduced.
ret.audio: <Audio 1>: reference - the song plays unchanged and times every cut.
texto.ninguno_mas: No other text appears on screen.
texto.encima: At {t} the huge word "{texto}" slams over the {encuadre|shot}, with <Subject 1>'s face still visible behind the letters[[, {estilo}]].
texto.encima_varias: At {t} the huge words "{texto}" slam over the {encuadre|shot}, with <Subject 1>'s face still visible behind the letters[[, {estilo}]].
texto.al_lado: At {t} the words "{texto}" appear {estilo|in bold clean white letters}, beside <Subject 1>, never covering {posesivo} face.
sonido: Only the music of <Audio 1>, unchanged, with no dialogue and no added sound effects.
musica: The song in <Audio 1> plays unchanged throughout the whole video.
